summary: Frontend-only regression for mobile checkout UX. Seeded scratch client -> site -> vendor(s) -> menu(3) -> employee via API; ran Playwright at 390x844 (mobile) and 1440x900 (desktop). ALL 12 mobile flows + ALL 3 desktop flows pass. Hamburger drawer, floating checkout bar (count + total live-update), bottom-sheet with vendor grouping/qty controls/keep-shopping/X close, cart persistence via localStorage.cravitoo_cart, empty->hide, and desktop sticky cart + Razorpay handoff all behave per contract. All previous data-testids (menu-item-{id}, add-to-cart-{id}, vendor-tab-{id}, cart-count, cart-total, place-order-btn, cart-item-{id}, cart-vendor-{id}, cart-qty-{id}, cart-section, empty-cart-message, vegetarian-icon) are preserved. Scratch data cleaned up via cascade DELETE — preview DB back to 1 user (admin).

issues: Duplicate data-testids: because the sticky desktop cart column (`hidden lg:block`) stays in the DOM on mobile and the sheet also renders the same testids, `cart-total`, `cart-count`, `cart-item-{id}`, `cart-qty-{id}`, `cart-vendor-{id}`, `increase-qty-{id}`, `decrease-qty-{id}`, `empty-cart-message` all appear TWICE at once whenever the mobile sheet is open (or on desktop where both would be duplicated if screen dips below lg during resize). Playwright strict-mode selectors fail without .last/.first, and any assistive tech reading the page will hear labels twice. RECOMMEND: change the `compact` branch of CartInner to emit suffixed testids (e.g., `cart-total-sheet`, `cart-qty-{id}-sheet`) OR conditionally render only ONE CartInner at a time based on viewport instead of relying on `hidden` CSS. Suffixed testids for the sheet are already used for `place-order-btn` vs `place-order-btn-sheet` and `cart-section` vs `cart-sheet-inner`, so the same pattern should be extended to the inner elements too.

No focus trap inside the bottom sheet or the Navbar mobile drawer — Tab key can leak focus behind the overlay to menu items. Not blocking (X + backdrop tap both close correctly), but a11y nice-to-have.

action_items: OPTIONAL (a11y/testing hygiene): suffix the inner cart data-testids inside the mobile sheet (e.g., `cart-total-sheet`, `cart-count-sheet`, `cart-qty-{id}-sheet`, `cart-vendor-{id}-sheet`, `increase-qty-{id}-sheet`, `decrease-qty-{id}-sheet`, `empty-cart-message-sheet`) so mobile+desktop don't emit duplicates. Right now the desktop `hidden lg:block` column stays in the DOM and clashes with the sheet's copy.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: cart persistence via localStorage.cravitoo_cart works across reload; verified value survives page refresh with floating button re-showing correct '3 items · ₹580'.
GOOD: handleCheckoutTap() picks the right branch on window.innerWidth >= 1024 (desktop scroll) vs mobile (open sheet).
GOOD: floating button toggles precisely at totalItemsInCart > 0 and disappears the moment the last decrement removes the vendor entry.
GOOD: Navbar mobile drawer has body-scroll lock and closes on route change AND on X — no infinite-open state observed.

MINOR: two <style>{keyframes}</style> tags are injected inline every time the drawer/sheet mounts. Consider moving `slideUp` and `slideRight` keyframes into index.css / tailwind config to avoid duplicated <style> tags in the DOM tree.

MINOR: CartInner is defined inside EmployeeMenu, so it gets a fresh component identity on every render — cheap here but a common source of re-mount bugs. Consider hoisting or wrapping in useMemo/useCallback.
